Four axes, briefly: the two colours are real customer teaching content, so the bare pattern's red on them is a false positive on correct metadata (business); a citation is a number with a non-word neighbour — the rule follows the thing, not a per-file waiver (long-term); a red that tells an agent its colour is an issue id pushes it to mangle the colour (prevent AI errors); about ten lines inside the existing gate, scoped to the root the ruling added, no new gate (focus).
